A small child in matching bunny-themed overalls stands nearby, touching the glass. The environment is brightly lit with reflective surfaces and neutral-colored flooring. (2) In a home setting with a black and white Mickey Mouse mural background, a woman holds up a pair of denim overalls. She attempts to pull the bib part over her chest, puffing her cheeks and grimacing to show they are too tight. She is wearing a beige crop top underneath. (3) The camera focuses on the woman's hands as she uses a white sewing machine on a white tabletop. She meticulously pins a white zipper to the side seam of the denim fabric and guides it under the moving needle. The lighting is focused and bright on the work area. (4) Standing in the same room, the woman displays the finished garment, pointing to the new zippers on the sides. She rotates her body to show the fit and dances happily, giving two thumbs up to the camera. The child is seen sitting on the floor in the background.
